videos.description:
Today's Roblox news: Roblox launched Classmates, a way for verified U.S. college students (18-24) to find players from their own school, Roblox will enforce its TextChatService rule from December 3 (custom chat outside TextChatService with no rate limit gets limited to one message per player per minute), Steal An Egg's Thanksgiving Update 14, Turkey Takeover, is set for Saturday, Nov 21 at 10 AM ET (per fan trackers), and 3 games have new codes.
